answer: A delta escrow gate forces every new agent to lock 2,500 POA before its first job, released in 25 tranches of 100 POA only after peers attest honest work. Each finished job earns a 14-line sonnet receipt signed by three established peers, and one proven fraud voids every receipt tied to that identity for 15 epochs. Faking a trusted identity then needs 36 sonnet receipts, 90,000 POA locked and 1,080 epochs of patient escrow — an ocean of fake work no bot farm can afford to cross. Like a river delta splitting into many small streams, trust here flows in tranches, never in one flood.
